headline: Supercharge Your Daily Workflow with AI Utilities
intro: Discover simple yet powerful ways to integrate everyday AI tools into your daily routine to save time, spark creativity, and streamline administrative tasks.
ideas: Automate inbox triage by using AI to summarize lengthy email threads and suggest context-aware draft replies.
Convert raw meeting recordings and voice notes into prioritized action items and executive summaries.
Repurpose long-form reports or articles into bite-sized social media updates and newsletter highlights.
Accelerate spreadsheet work by using conversational prompts to generate complex formulas and debug syntax errors.
Synthesize research faster by comparing key takeaways across multiple PDFs and research papers in one view.
tips: Provide clear context upfront, including your target audience, tone of voice, and preferred output length.
Refine through iteration by asking follow-up questions rather than restarting the conversation with a new prompt.
Always review critical outputs manually, treating generated drafts as collaborative starting points rather than final facts.
